messages:
Elaine H: Quick sync for the Acme POC — they want an on-prem, air-gapped deploy. Main asks: packaging formats we support (rpm/deb/docker/oci), offline install flow, upgrade cadence (patch vs minor vs major), and how pricing differs between Dedicated vs Private. Can someone confirm?

Vikram R: For packaging: we can do an OCI image + tarball of runtime + a small installer. Customers in highly restricted envs usually want: 1) OCI images exported as tar/registry bundle, 2) a signed artifact bundle (sha256) and 3) explicit HF/OCI manifest for offline registry import.

Vikram R: Short list: rpm/deb for system installs, container image for k8s, and a self-contained tarball for air-gapped VMs. We don't ship a raw binary installer except for internal customers.

Jorge P: Is there an existing offline install playbook we can share? Acme asked for step-by-step with commands and expected ports. If not, can we put together a minimal one pager? :point_up:

Vikram R: I have a draft. Example offline import steps for k8s:

```
# on bastion with registry access
skopeo copy docker://registry.redwood.com/redwood/runtime:1.2.0 dir:./bundle
tar -czf redwood-bundle-1.2.0.tar.gz ./bundle
# customer moves tar to air-gapped cluster
# on customer side
tar -xzf redwood-bundle-1.2.0.tar.gz
ctr images import ./bundle/runtime.tar
kubectl apply -f redwood-deploy.yaml --namespace redwood
```

Vikram R: We'll sign the tar with our release key and provide checksums.

Maria S: Security Qs: Acme's infosec will want the SBOM, FIPS/tls versions, cert rotation docs, KMS integration options (they use HashiCorp Vault), and our vulnerability disclosure timeline. Also they asked about upgrade rollback strategy in air-gapped mode.

Maria S: For SBOM we provide CycloneDX JSON per release. For certs we support customer-provided certs (they can mount via secret or use Vault PKI). For KMS we have an HSM/KMS integration guide — works offline if Vault is reachable or via offline key import.

Elaine H: Great. On pricing they want to compare: 1) Dedicated (reserved GPU pool hosted by us), 2) Private (customer-hosted licensed deployment + support). They asked whether Private includes free upgrades for X months and whether we charge for install assistance.

Jorge P: Standard commercial: Private is a perpetual platform license + annual support fee. Upgrades are included for the first 6 months of support; after that we offer a paid upgrade SLA (per-upgrade or annual subscription). Install assistance is billable as a professional services engagement unless covered in their support tier. We can offer a limited number of complimentary migration hours (usually 20) for new enterprise deals.

Maria S: Also note: for air-gapped installs we require a minimal managed channel for license checks unless they sign an offline license agreement. That needs legal approval — flag to AMs.

Elaine H: Acme also asked about upgrade cadence: how often do we do major/minor/patch?

Vikram R: Our release cadence: patch releases (security/bugfix) monthly, minor feature releases quarterly, major releases ~annually. For Private, we recommend scheduling upgrades during off-peak windows; we provide upgrade scripts that support in-place minor upgrades and blue/green for major ones. For air-gapped customers we test the bundle in a staging image and provide a preflight checklist.

Maria S: Rollback for air-gapped: we provide snapshot/backup commands and a documented rollback procedure. But rollback success depends on DB schema migrations — we recommend feature flags for risky changes and a canary subset rollout.

Elaine H: Anything blocking before I send the answers to Acme and attach the draft install playbook?

Jorge P: Need legal to sign offline license clause and PS estimate. I'll ping legal and ops.

Maria S: I'll attach the SBOM template and the cert/Vault integration notes.

Vikram R: I'll clean up the installer snippet and add expected ports (6443, 2379, 9090, 8080) + resource requirements (2x A100 or 8x T4 equiv for their baseline).

deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created: https://internal.redwood.com/ops/checklists/airgap-poc-1763745600 — contains offline bundle steps, checksum verification, and rollback plan.

Elaine H: Perfect — I'll consolidate and send to Acme by EOD. Thanks all :rocket:
